SECURITY:
  Managed identity has subscription-level Contributor
  DB accepts traffic from the full subnet, not a
  private endpoint

code:
COST OPTIMIZATION:
  Cluster sized for Black Friday peak, year-round
  Min node count set far above baseline demand

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE:
  No on-call routing, no rollback runbook

PERFORMANCE EFFICIENCY:
  CPU-bound workload on memory-optimized nodes
caption: Five pillars, five independent findings, one architecture.
